title: Deployed upload path rejects permitted PDF sizes above approximately1MiB
environment: Authenticated UAT, runtime SHA independently attested, only unique owned synthetic cases/documents
preconditions: Valid PDF generated by LawDesk own-prefix report export
Create own synthetic case; no customer/legal record mutation
steps: Use valid synthetic PDF padded to1047552bytes; observe201 and delete owned attachment
Exactly10485760bytes also returns413; independent same-source local backend accepts exactly10MiB
expected: Each valid file up to10MiB returns201 with correct bytes/hash; multipart transport allowance includes overhead
component_evidence: LawDesk frontend/nginx.conf has no explicit client_max_body_size. Response-size boundary is consistent with a request-path limit; no shared proxy configuration was inspected or modified. Investigate/fix LawDesk-owned web configuration first.
fix_guidance: Align the isolated LawDesk web/proxy request allowance with a10MiB file plus multipart overhead. Keep backend file validation. Do not modify Matbakhy/shared proxy. Retest valid PDF boundary, oversized rejection and UI error display.

retests.note: Valid PDF below/above1MiB and exact10MiB accepted; overlimit400; bytes/hash/case checks, quota race and role checks. Additional two-size persistence in document-persistence.
